daily.brief: 過去約26小時，78個帳號共發出235則帖文，幾乎所有目光都盯著Nvidia執行長相關消息。盤後股價大跌引發明顯分歧，有人擔心領導層出現真空，也有人堅持GPU需求不會因此改變，同時部分帳號把AMD視為潛在受惠者。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好主要落在$AMD。@wallstengine 指出William Blair因Nvidia潛在領導真空而上調評級至Outperform，預期2027年營收增長超過80%，數據中心AI營收將在第四季超越其伺服器CPU業務。原帖 @Frenchie_ 詳述執行長醜聞，涉及與Kimberly Powell的第二段關係，董事會開會可能罷免，盤後 $NVDA 跌8%，本周市值損失約6000億美元，Bernstein將倍數與目標價從400美元下調。原帖 @EliteOptions2 分享交易計劃，關注辭職官方新聞，可能使股價再跌至153，而 $AMD 盤後升25+，目標看至600。原帖

共同看淡

這段期間沒有形成明顯的共同看淡股票。

分歧

最大分歧在$NVDA，7個帳號看好、7個看淡。@aleabitoreddit 認為Jensen Huang幾乎不可替代，就像從TSLA拿掉Elon會令估值與信心崩潰，他對CUDA、Neocloud、供應鏈與機架級系統有遠見。原帖 @Mr_Derivatives 則說玩笑話不談，終究仍需要GPU來推動AI革命，$NVDA最終會走出這個困境。原帖 @daniel_koss 分析11人董事會移除需要6票，列出現有忠誠者、搖擺票與獨立董事，認為董事會清楚知道保留黃仁勳符合Nvidia經濟利益。原帖

其他分歧包括$MU有人看到3天內從667升至828的技術買點，也有人因Nvidia消息受影響；$NBIS @ACInvestorBlog 認為131美元是便宜貨、下行有限，但@StockSavvyShay 報導下跌近15%；$SPCX有人看到如果黃仁勳去與Elon一起工作會漲，也有嚴重指控的消息。

其他值得留意

@Mr_Derivatives 提到 $GOOGL 現在接近超越 $NVDA 成為世界第三大公司。@DeItaone 引述HSBC「不要浪費一個好的拋售」並列出包括 $GOOGL 在內的11隻買入股票。$ONDS 有Q3業績超預期的報導，@StockSavvyShay 提到收入1.68億美元對比預期1.48億美元。$MNTS 有在美國戰爭部合約下太空機器人組裝取得進展的正面消息。

daily.brief: Over roughly the past 26 hours, 78 accounts posted 235 related items, with nearly all attention on news around Nvidia's CEO. The after-hours share price drop sparked clear divergence, with some worried about a leadership vacuum and others insisting GPU demand would not change because of it, while some accounts viewed AMD as a potential beneficiary.
daily.full:
Consensus

Common bullish views mainly centered on $AMD. @wallstengine noted William Blair upgraded to Outperform citing a potential Nvidia leadership vacuum, expecting revenue growth over 80% in 2027 and data center AI revenue to surpass server CPU business in Q4. Post @Frenchie_ detailed the CEO scandal involving a second relationship with Kimberly Powell, possible board removal, $NVDA down 8% after hours, about $600 billion market cap loss this week, and Bernstein cutting the multiple and target from $400. Post @EliteOptions2 shared a trading plan, watching for official resignation news that could send the price to 153, while $AMD rose 25+ after hours with a target to 600. Post

Common Bearish

No clear common bearish stocks formed during this period.

Split

The biggest split is on $NVDA, with 7 accounts bullish and 7 bearish. @aleabitoreddit argues Jensen Huang is almost irreplaceable, like removing Elon from TSLA would crash valuation and confidence, citing his vision on CUDA, supply chain and rack-scale systems. Post @Mr_Derivatives says jokes aside, GPUs are still needed to drive the AI revolution and $NVDA will eventually get through this. Post @daniel_koss analyzes that removing him from the 11-person board needs 6 votes, lists loyalists and others, and believes the board knows keeping Huang is in Nvidia's economic interest. Post

Other splits include $MU with some seeing a technical buy after rising from 667 to 828 in 3 days, others affected by Nvidia news; $NBIS with @ACInvestorBlog calling 131 a bargain with limited downside, but @StockSavvyShay reporting nearly 15% drop; $SPCX with some seeing upside if Huang joins Elon, others noting serious allegations.

Other Notable

@Mr_Derivatives noted $GOOGL is now close to surpassing $NVDA as the world's third-largest company. @DeItaone cited HSBC saying “don't waste a good sell-off” and listing 11 buy stocks including $GOOGL. $ONDS had Q3 earnings beat reports, with @StockSavvyShay mentioning revenue of $168 million vs $148 million expected. $MNTS had positive news on space robotics assembly progress under a US Department of War contract.
